text: At its meeting held on October 2 and 3, 2019, City Council adopted Item TE8.11, with amendments, which recommended amendments to Zoning By-laws 438-86 and 569-2013 to permit redevelopment of 56 Yonge Street, 21 Melinda Street, 18 to 30 Wellington Street West, 187 to 199 Bay Street and 25 King Street West for a 65-storey office building and a 3-storey glass pavilion. The Bills enacting the amending Zoning By-laws are prepared for this meeting of Council. The applicant is requesting the maximum office gross floor area identified in the draft amending Zoning By-laws be increased from 315,000 square metres to 335,000 square metres based on recent survey of the existing office space below grade on the subject site. The increase in office gross floor area does not alter the building envelope or the overall 368,100 square metres of gross floor area provisions in the amending Zoning By-laws as…
